scope: Capture bounded OCR child diagnostics privately and distinguish timeout, launch, nonzero-exit, and missing-output outcomes without losing native text or exposing raw diagnostic content.

evidence.summary: 48 tests passed; includes OCR unit failures, parser regressions, profile/API isolation and Chromium warning review.
35 browser tests passed. A known feedback-GUI client-disconnect traceback was printed during a passing test; it did not fail the suite.
680 tests ran; zero failures/errors; one optional PostgreSQL test skipped because MJOBS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL was unset.

evidence.command: npm run build --prefix apps/web; npm test --prefix apps/web -- --run; python -m tools.verification.agent_skills; python -m tools.verification.catalogue; python -m tools.verification.progress validate; git diff --check
evidence.summary: Strict TypeScript/Vite build, all 62 frontend tests, skill/catalogue/progress validators and diff whitespace check passed.

evidence.command: docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=128m --memory 1g --cpus 1 --pids-limit 128 --mount <worktree OCR module to /app/services/career_profile/ocr.py:ro> mjobs-local:spine python -m cli.profile_ocr_e2e; then synthetic nonzero child diagnostic-boundary script
evidence.summary: Isolated no-network Linux container ran actual Poppler/Tesseract, SQLite API and Chromium review. Synthetic child exit 7 captured 20,018 stderr bytes, retained only 16,384 bytes of size metadata, marked truncation, and exposed no private marker.

test_first_red.failure: Before implementation a nonzero OCR child result did not report its exit status and fell through to the generic resource-limit warning.

non_reproducible_test_events.failure: Initial full run loaded stale ignored apps/web/dist and failed the core workflow Sources-copy assertion. Current source contained the copy while generated dist did not. Rebuilding apps/web fixed it; the isolated browser test and later same-head full suite passed.

One unrelated CompanyDiscoveryRequestsBrowserTests Uvicorn server-thread shutdown assertion exceeded its join during full-suite load. The test passed alone, all 35 browser tests passed, and the exact same source head then passed the 680-test full rerun. No timeout was changed.

requirement_limitations: Native parser/OCR request-disconnect cancellation is not yet implemented.
Real ATS navigation/provider and AI request paths are unavailable; broader per-category output, retry and error-classification contracts remain open.
Hosted checks/reviews are NOT_RUN by explicit local-only policy.
